title: Seeds and Forks
subtitle: Deterministic simulation and fork time travel for a TanStack Start app on workerd

chapters.title: The Obvious Shop Loses Receipts
chapters.blurb: Read the stock, work out what is left, write it back. Two requests interleave, and 1,978 of 2,000 seeded schedules break.

chapters.title: Seeds Pick the Order
chapters.blurb: The simulator picks what happens next from a seeded draw. The same seed gives the same bytes in a new process, on stock workerd or Replay's.

chapters.title: Replay Opens the Failure
chapters.blurb: Record one failing seed, replay it to the same hash, step through 19,452 JavaScript steps, and compare three fixes by how many seeds still fail.

chapters.title: Fork Both Sides at One Moment
chapters.blurb: A fork copies the page and the worker at one moment and runs on. Buy in the forked page reaches the forked worker and returns the real receipt.

chapters.title: Load New Code, Then Find the Edges
chapters.blurb: Hot-load a new price into a fork, see what a fork cannot do yet, and read the definition of done as it is measured.
